Riya (AE): FinBank asked in the SIG follow-up: need evidence that admin console actions, API key rotations, and emergency access are logged and that exported logs can be made immutable for 12 months. They prefer Splunk. Can we deliver an evidence packet for POC in 48h?

Tom (SE): Yes. We'll produce: small audit export (JSONL) with examples of role.assign, api_key.rotate, assume_role; a manifest.sha256; Splunk HEC sample config; and a short attestation note. Hosted retention is 90d, so export to customer S3 with object-lock=COMPLIANCE + their KMS key is the recommended path.

Sam (InfoSec): We'll redact emails by default. Include a redaction appendix that shows original vs redacted lines. Attestation will state scope (hosted, date range), fields redacted, and contact security@redwood.com.

Nora (Customer Sec): Their vendor team will want wording about COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE object-lock. Please call out that COMPLIANCE prevents deletion by any principal for the retention period.

ExportAgent: export started for 1798200000 (range: 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-03). ETA ~45m.

Tom (SE): Splunk HEC example to include in runbook:
curl -s https://splunk.fingroup.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-04-02T10:12:00Z","actor":"admin@finbank.com","action":"api_key.rotate","resource":"svc-ledger"}}'

Tom (SE): Sample manifest line format in bundle: 
# manifest.sha256
# bundle-20260402-0001.jsonl  e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...

ExportAgent: slice ready: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1798200000/slice-2026-04-02.zip

Riya (AE): I'll tell FinBank they have a slice to review and ask for a brief call to walk through verification (sha256sum -c manifest.sha256).

Sam (InfoSec): I'll prepare the attestation PDF and redaction appendix now.

Nora (Customer Sec): Received the slice. Looks good. Will validate presence of api_key.rotate events.

ExportAgent: final bundle uploaded (1798200000/final-bundle-2026-04-03.zip) - files: audit.jsonl, manifest.sha256, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1798200000/final-bundle-2026-04-03.zip

Riya (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update FinBank and mark the questionnaire item as satisfied for now.
